name: remove-utm
description:
The URL without its UTM tags, the parameters whose name starts with «utm_» in any case.

«https://site.ru/?UTM_Source=ya&utm_medium=cpc&id=5#top» → «https://site.ru/?id=5#top». The rest of the query stays after one «?» and between single «&»; with no parameter left, the «?» goes too.

Example: semkit read --text "https://site.ru/?utm_source=ya&utm_medium=cpc&id=5" remove-utm write -
-> https://site.ru/?id=5

The step rewrites the working column; with --as NAME it writes the result to a new column NAME.

options.name: --as
options.description: Write the result to a new column NAME and keep the working column as it is.
